name: XCC_DATA_SETS
description: The table contains a row for each call to the budgetary control engine.  It contains the parameters the engine was run with, the return budgetary control status, and the transfer status.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this budgetary control engine run.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the type of transaction.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action that occurred on the transaction or set of transactions.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger to be processed in this budgetary control engine run. It is required for all products other than GL, XLA and XCC.

columns.name: RESERVATION_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Reservation mode can be either DRAFT or FINAL.

columns.name: CALLING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calling method can be ONLINE_SINGLE, ONLINE_BATCH, BACKEND_SINGLE or BACKEND_BATCH.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Override mode is either NONE, OVERRIDE or CHECK.

columns.name: RESULT_CODE
columns.description: Resulting funds status such as SUCCESS, WARNING, PARTIAL, FAILED, MIXED, ERROR, NOT_APPLICABLE.

columns.name: FATAL_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message in the case of fatal errors.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if override is available.  Value is always No unless the override mode is CHECK and one or more distributions failed funds validation.

columns.name: TRANSFER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the transfer to essbase can be NOT_READY, READY, TRANSFERRED, NOT_APPLICABLE.

columns.name: NEEDS_PURGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the pending activities for this data set need to be purged.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_USER_GUID
columns.description: Current user for the purposes of overrides. May be different from the actual user calling funds reservation in some circumstances.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_REASON
columns.description: Justification for the override.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any of the transactions in the data set have been overridden.

columns.name: SUMMARIZED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if summarized amounts across all the transactions in the data set are available in a dummy header.

columns.name: REPROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether data set is reprocessed. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
